newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium state notes raised 13.06 bln Bfr to date.
newsitem.headline: Belgium state notes raised 13.06 bln Bfr to date.

text.p: Belgium's Finance Ministry said on Monday it raised 13.06 billion Belgian francs by the third day of subscriptions to its latest issue of state notes.
A ministry statement said subscriptions to its five-year state note, extendable to seven years, amounted to 8.70 billion francs.
For the 3/5/7 note - which carries a guaranteed minimum coupon and put options at three, five and seven years - subscriptions amounted to 4.36 billion francs.
Subscriptions opened on September 11 and end on Tuesday.
The notes will be issued on September 18.

It is the second time Belgium is offering these medium-term notes, which are a new state investment product targetted at the general public. The first issue in June raised a total of 16.65 billion Belgian francs.
The ministry has said it will carry out four such issues a year, aiming to raise around 85 billion francs towards its borrowing needs.
